# Shared team rituals with roles

Habits go further together. A **ritual** is a team-scoped habit a lead curates
and members join. This ticket introduces roles so ownership is explicit without
turning Cadence into a permissions maze.

## Roles

- **Owner** — creates and edits the ritual, sets its cadence.
- **Member** — joins, checks in, leaves; cannot edit the ritual.

### Permission matrix

| Action              | Owner | Member |
|---------------------|-------|--------|
| Create ritual       | yes   | no     |
| Edit cadence        | yes   | no     |
| Join / check in     | yes   | yes    |
| Remove a member     | yes   | no     |
| Leave the ritual    | yes   | yes    |

## Notes

1. A ritual reuses the same append-only event store; a check-in on a ritual is
   just an event tagged with the ritual id.
2. Removing a member stops future participation but never rewrites history.
3. Deleting a ritual is soft — events are retained for the team heatmap.[^soft]

```python
def can_edit(role):
    return role is Role.OWNER
```

This is the last v2 backend epic before analytics.

[^soft]: History is immutable by construction (CAD-100); "delete" only hides the
ritual from active boards.
